summary: Testing of MVP Field Inventory System iteration 5. Fixed critical bug: Audit page was returning 500 error due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue. All other features working correctly.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge in bottom-right corner - this is an external platform widget that cannot be removed via code (platform limitation)

passed_tests: Export Page - 2 buttons for tables (Просмотр, Скачать)
Export Page - 3 buttons for catalog (Просмотр, Скачать, Печать)
QR Batches Page - Create dialog with all label_data fields (ОИВ, Этаж, Управление, Отдел, Место, МОЛ)
QR Batches Page - 3 action buttons per batch (Просмотр, Скачать, Печать)
QR Batch PDF API /api/qr-batches/{id}/pdf returns PDF (HTTP 200)
Import Page - Button 'Далее → Проверить данные' present
Import Page - Hint message when no mapping selected
Audit Page - Loads correctly and shows history (19 records)
Rates Page - Calculator shows values from DB

fixed_issues.issue: Audit page returning 500 Internal Server Error
fixed_issues.root_cause: MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in nested 'changes' field

critical_code_review_comments: Rates in DB are S=40, M=50, L=60 - different from expected S=50, M=100, L=200. This is a data issue, not code issue. Admin can update rates via UI.
